name: TOI-677
description: Star of 6,295 K, 142 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: TOI-677 b crosses TOI-677 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Jordán et al. 2020.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (st_refname JORD_AACUTE_N_ET_AL__2020): st_teff 6295, st_rad 1.28, st_mass 1.181

quotes.title: TOI-677 b
quotes.card: TOI-677 b (TOI-677b) is a warm super-Jupiter type exoplanet orbiting the F-type main sequence star TOI-677 in the constellation of Ophiuchus about 466 ly (143 pc) away from Earth.
quotes.introduction: The mass of the planet has been found to be 1.252 Jupiter masses and the radius of the planet is 1.179 Jupiter radii.
